messages:
morgan: Heads-up — merge window for the upcoming release (train on 2026-03-12) closes Wed 2026-03-11 17:00 UTC. Please get PRs into main or mark for backport. If you need a late exception, reply with reason + approver. Add a one-line changelog entry to CHANGES.md in your PR or add the `changelog: needed` label. I moved the calendar invite to Thu 18:00 UTC to avoid the US regional holiday — double-check your calendar. :calendar:

jules: Thanks — quick q: which branch should hotfixes target this cycle? main or `release/2026-03-12`? Also pinging @sam for any runtime-sensitive changes.

sam: Hotfixes -> `release/2026-03-12` preferred. Anything touching runtime or batching needs 2 reviewers + the perf-check pipeline green. If you expect to push changes after Tue, add a note here so I can prioritize reviews.

ana: (typo fixed) ana: small docs-only PR — just a changelog bullet. Will that block?

morgan: docs-only are fine to roll. Please add the `docs` label and set merge-on-green. Not a blocker.

liz: Quick timezone note — APAC folks: if you won't be able to merge during the cutoff, add a `merge-delegate:@<name>` label and the delegate will cover merges for you.

release-bot: Scheduled reminder: auto-backport job will run Tue 2026-03-10 12:00 UTC. Command example: ```/release backport --to release/2026-03-12 --pr 1234``` (will only run for PRs with `backport: approved`).

sam: FYI I pushed a small batching tweak in #1247 -> will cause perf-check to rerun. @morgan please ping when you're about to cut so I can prioritize the pipeline.

jules: Changelog nudge — owners for these PRs please add bullets by EOD Tue: #1215, #1221, #1234. I gathered short descriptions in the draft changelog doc.

morgan: To make this easy, checklist for owners: 1) add one-line changelog to PR 2) add labels (`changelog: needed` / `docs` / `regression`) 3) request 2 reviewers 4) set milestone=2026-03-12. If you can't meet EOD, post here and we'll evaluate exceptions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
